//: Editor-time / CI type checking for the src JavaScript. Not part of the webpack build (wp-scripts handles bundling). checkJs is false so only files with an explicit `// @ts-check` pragma are checked; the src/admin scripts and the non-JSX block transform/helper files opt in. JSX edit panels are parsed (jsx: preserve) but not checked. Types for the PHP-injected config objects and WP/browser globals come from the globals.d.ts files. Run `npx -y --package typescript tsc -p jsconfig.json`.
